Definition: a mark; by implication, a signature
BiblicalUsage: The word is a mark, a signature. In Ezekiel's vision the man with the inkhorn is told to set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and cry for the abominations done in Jerusalem, and the destroyers are told to come not near any man upon whom is the mark. Job wishes his adversary had written a book, and cries, Oh that one would hear me, behold, my desire is that the Almighty would answer me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mark is God's signature on His own, set before the judgment falls, and no destroyer touches the marked. My position is that God knows His people by name and by mark, and He marks them first.
